predecessor_disclosure: V11 held-out results were observed and failed. V12 is a structural successor, not a retuning of V11; the V11 frozen file remains immutable.
reference_system: Gong et al. 2024 open-cathode air-cooled 40-cell PEMFC stack
scope: thermal digital twin; electrochemical voltage is a measured exogenous input and not a predicted state

state_resolution.delivered_layout: 40 cells x 6 cathode-flow finite volumes x 10 in-plane finite volumes x 2 thermal masses
state_resolution.reported_sensor_layout: area aggregation to 40 x 3 x 5 physical regions

structural_changes_from_v11: all conductive and convective coefficients scale by finite-volume face area and distance
intercell transport uses effective through-stack conductivity rather than conductance per region
a two-capacitance solid/contact structure represents fast plate and slow assembly response
PWM-to-flow uses a bounded nonlinear fan-law exponent above the published 12 percent start threshold
the annular fan footprint is mixed in a plenum before entering the 40 cell paths
experiment-specific measured voltage anchors close the electrical-to-thermal energy balance
ambient temperature is an experimental input, not forced equal to initial stack temperature
decision_rule: Every thermal, mesh, energy, and independent-implementation gate must pass before the model may supply a ROM, observer, or controller reference trajectory.
pre_freeze_amendment: Fig.9 re-audit separated input event times from temperature observation times. A bounded fan-release time constant was added because PWM telemetry is not published and the paper explicitly attributes dynamic behaviour to fan/current timing. A 1200-state identification mesh is used for optimization, but the delivered plant is the mesh-converged 4800-state discretization checked against a 19200-state fine mesh. This amendment occurred before any V12 parameter freeze and uses calibration Fig.9(a) only.
